name: STA302H1 — Correction Attribution (Geometry of Least Squares)
description: 'Correlation implies causation.' NO! Regression shows ASSOCIATION. Ice cream sales ↔ drowning (both ↑ in summer). CONFOUNDER = temperature. Regression

steps.template_en: 'Correlation implies causation.' NO! Regression shows ASSOCIATION. Ice cream sales ↔ drowning (both ↑ in summer). CONFOUNDER = temperature. Regression doesn't identify causes.
steps.template_zh: '相关=因果。'不！回归展示关联。冰淇淋↔溺水(都夏天↑)。混杂=温度。回归不识别因果。

steps.template_en: Geometric: Y in ℝⁿ. Columns of X span subspace. β̂=(XᵀX)⁻¹XᵀY = PROJECTION of Y onto subspace. Ŷ=HY (H=hat matrix). e=Y-Ŷ=(I-H)Y orthogonal to column space.
steps.template_zh: 几何：Y在ℝⁿ中。X列张成子空间。β̂=Y的投影。Ŷ=HY。e正交于列空间。

steps.template_en: Gauss-Markov: Any linear θ̂=cᵀY. Unbiased ⟺ cᵀX=eⱼᵀ. Var(cᵀY)=σ²‖c‖². OLS c₀=X(XᵀX)⁻¹eⱼ. For any c=c₀+a with aᵀX=0: ‖c‖²=‖c₀‖²+‖a‖²≥‖c₀‖². OLS minimizes variance.
steps.template_zh: Gauss-Markov证明：OLS方差最小。任何线性无偏估计c=c₀+a，其中aᵀX=0。‖c‖²=‖c₀‖²+‖a‖²≥‖c₀‖²。

steps.template_en: Geometry clarifies: (1) R²=cos²(θ) where θ = angle between Y and Ŷ. (2) Adding predictors NEVER reduces R². (3) Orthogonal = independent estimates. (4) F-test = ratio of squared projection lengths.
steps.template_zh: 几何澄清：(1)R²=cos²(θ)。(2)添加变量从不降低R²。(3)正交=独立估计。(4)F检验=投影长度平方比。

steps.template_en: (1) Show H symmetric and idempotent. (2) I-H also symmetric idempotent. (3) e ⟂ Ŷ. (4) Prove E[MSE]=σ². (5) In R: compute H for simple regression.
steps.template_zh: (1)证明H对称幂等。(2)I-H也对称幂等。(3)e⟂Ŷ。(4)E[MSE]=σ²。(5)R中计算简单回归的H。

steps.template_en: Geometric view UNIFIES: regression = projection, ANOVA = decomposition into orthogonal subspaces, mixed models = projection onto random effects. Understanding ℝⁿ projections → understanding linear models.
steps.template_zh: 几何视角统一：回归=投影，ANOVA=正交子空间分解，混合模型=投影到随机效应。
